basic_info.description: Welcome to 1261 Grove Street  #6, a charming top-floor Edwardian gem in the heart of San Francisco's Alamo Square! This South-facing unit offers a bright and serene green vista, creating a peaceful retreat in the city's most vibrant neighborhood.     As you step inside, you'll be greeted by classic Edwardian details that blend seamlessly with modern amenities including in-unit washer & dryer. The two spacious bedrooms provide ample space for relaxation and creativity, while the well-appointed bathroom ensures comfort and convenience. Gaze upon a beautiful backyard walnut tree from the comfort and privacy of your primary bedroom, or open it up with the French doors for added flex space.    Storage won't be a challenge with a generous additional storage locker and separate, secured lower-level bike storage, keeping your belongings organized and accessible. The vibrant shopping, dining, and nightlife of Divisadero Street are just steps away, offering endless entertainment options. In the other direction, you'll find the picturesque Alamo Square Park, perfect for leisurely strolls and outdoor enjoyment.    Don't miss the opportunity to make this delightful TIC residence your new home. Experience the best of San Francisco living at 1261 Grove Street #6. Schedule your tour today!
